description: This file defines the interface for managing receipt lists in the OvsDbApi component, including functions for adding receipts, processing receipts, and clearing the receipt list.

methods.name: receipt_list_add
methods.description: Adds a receipt to the receipt list with the specified receipt ID and callback.

methods.name: receipt_list_process
methods.description: Processes receipts associated with the given receipt ID and JSON result.

methods.name: receipt_list_clear
methods.description: Clears all receipts from the receipt list.
